subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this PR require retained after-fix Discord transcript/log/video proof before merge, or may maintainers intentionally accept the unretained canary observation after the branch conflict is resolved?
rationale: The source diff looks narrow, but external PR proof remains uninspectable and the change affects channel-visible message delivery, so automation cannot safely waive the proof gate without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require retained Discord proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs after the conflict is resolved before merge.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly own the message-delivery risk and merge from source/tests plus the unretained canary observation once the branch is clean.

options.title: Pause until proof is practical
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked if neither the contributor nor a maintainer can capture the Discord path yet.

recommendation.title: Require retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted after-fix Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs after the conflict is resolved before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the current Discord draft callback and shared progress-rendering code touched by the PR.
